resp.attack_hostile: So be it! You will regret this!
resp.gift_friendly: A generous gift! You are most kind.
resp.already_known: Yes, I already knew that. But thank you for confirming.
resp.learned: Interesting... I had not heard this before. Thank you.

quest.reward: You have my gratitude. Here is your reward.

quest.find_brother.title: Find My Brother
quest.find_brother.desc: A merchant named Nabu lost track of his brother during the sack of Ugarit. He was last seen heading toward Byblos.
quest.deliver_letter.title: Deliver the King's Letter
quest.deliver_letter.desc: Captain Hatt needs a sealed letter delivered to the Temple. He doesn't trust the regular messengers.
quest.deliver_letter.obj: Deliver the letter to Priestess Elissa
quest.copper_shipment.title: Copper Shipment
quest.copper_shipment.desc: Hepar the Smith needs copper from Cyprus. Find a sailor who knows the trade route.
quest.copper_shipment.obj: Ask Wenamun about the Cyprus trade route
quest.defend_camp.title: Defend the Refugee Camp
quest.defend_camp.desc: Mara warns that raiders are approaching. Defeat 5 enemies near her position.
fact.ugarit_sack.merchant_1: The port was overrun at night. I barely escaped with my ledger.
fact.sea_peoples.merchant_1: They came from the west — ships unlike any I have seen before.
fact.byblos_king.guard_1: The King grows desperate. He has been asking for foreign troops.
fact.sea_peoples.guard_1: They struck Ugarit first. We are fortifying the walls.
fact.sea_peoples.pirate_1: They are not the enemy you should fear, little merchant.
fact.copper_trade.pirate_1: Cyprus still ships copper. For now.
fact.ugarit_sack.priest_1: The gods have turned their back on us. The omens were clear.
fact.byblos_king.priest_1: The King sacrifices daily. He fears more than just the Sea Peoples.
fact.ugarit_sack.refugee_1: I lost everything. My husband, my home... the flames were visible for miles.
fact.sea_peoples.refugee_1: They take no prisoners. They burn everything.
fact.copper_trade.smith_1: The price of copper has tripled this season. War is good for my trade but bad for my soul.
fact.byblos_king.smith_1: He ordered a thousand spearheads last week. A thousand.
fact.copper_trade.scribe_1: The palace archives record copper shipments from Alashiya for 200 years. Those records are now ash.
fact.byblos_king.scribe_1: The King of Byblos sent envoys to Egypt last month. Pharaoh refused them.
fact.sea_peoples.sailor_1: I have seen their ships on the horizon. Three times this season. They are circling like vultures.
fact.copper_trade.sailor_1: The trade route to Alashiya is still open if you are brave enough. Few are.
fact.sea_peoples.warlord_1: I lost three men to them last week. They are more organized than people think.
fact.sea_peoples.mercenary_captain: I have been hired to protect caravans. Double the usual rate. Everyone is scared.
fact.byblos_king.mercenary_captain: The King pays well for swords. But loyalty is cheaper than gold.
fact.sea_peoples.hunter_1: I found their tracks along the northern shore. They have scouts inland.
fact.copper_trade.hunter_1: The old trade roads are unsafe. I saw a caravan ambushed last moon.
fact.sea_peoples.fisher_1: I saw their ships from my boat. They travel in threes — two strike, one waits.
fact.copper_trade.fisher_1: Cyprus ships still pass by. Fewer than before, but they pass.
fact.ugarit_sack.healer_1: I treated the survivors. The stories they told... I cannot repeat them.
fact.byblos_king.healer_1: The King's physician bought all my medicines last week. Someone important is ill.
fact.ugarit_sack.beggar_1: I was in the lower city when they came. The screams... I still hear them.
fact.byblos_king.beggar_1: The rich flee north. The poor die. It has always been this way.
mp.title: Multiplayer
mp.hosting_hint: Tell your friend to connect to your IP
fact.thornhaven_fall.merchant_1: The raid came at dawn. I barely grabbed my ledger before the gate fell.
fact.ashen_pact.merchant_1: They wear grey cloaks and speak in whispers. I've seen them watching the old road.
fact.ironholt_warden.guard_1: The Warden has called every able hand to the wall. Something's coming from the peaks.
fact.ashen_pact.guard_1: They struck Thornhaven first. We found strange symbols carved into the ruins.
fact.ashen_pact.pirate_1: The Pact isn't what you should fear, merchant. The things in the deep are waking up.
fact.relic_trade.pirate_1: Mistwood still ships relics. For now. The causeway gets harder to cross each month.
fact.thornhaven_fall.priest_1: I saw it in the smoke three nights before. The old gods have turned their faces away.
fact.ironholt_warden.priest_1: The Warden lights a candle every dusk. He fears more than just the Ashen Pact.
fact.thornhaven_fall.refugee_1: I lost everything. My home, my family... the flames lit the sky for miles.
fact.ashen_pact.refugee_1: They take no prisoners. They leave nothing but ash and silence.
fact.relic_trade.smith_1: The price of iron has tripled this season. War is bad for peace but good for my craft.
fact.ironholt_warden.smith_1: He ordered a thousand spearheads last week. A thousand.
fact.relic_trade.scribe_1: The old archives mention a city beneath the hills. I think Mistwood knows more than it tells.
fact.ironholt_warden.scribe_1: The Warden sent riders to the coast last month. They didn't come back.
fact.ashen_pact.sailor_1: I've seen their grey sails on the horizon. Three times this season. They're circling.
fact.relic_trade.sailor_1: The route to Mistwood is still open if you're brave enough. Few are.
fact.ashen_pact.warlord_1: I lost three good fighters to them last week. They move like they know the ground.
fact.ashen_pact.mercenary_captain: The pay is good for guarding caravans these days. Everyone's scared, and scared people pay double.
fact.ironholt_warden.mercenary_captain: The Warden pays well for swords. But loyalty costs more than gold.
fact.ashen_pact.hunter_1: I found their tracks along the old north road. They have scouts everywhere.
fact.relic_trade.hunter_1: The trade roads aren't safe anymore. I saw a caravan ambushed last full moon.
fact.ashen_pact.fisher_1: I saw their boats from my skiff. They travel in threes — two strike, one waits offshore.
fact.relic_trade.fisher_1: Mistwood boats still pass by. Fewer than before, but they still come.
fact.thornhaven_fall.healer_1: I treated the survivors who made it out. The wounds weren't made by any blade I know.
fact.ironholt_warden.healer_1: The Warden's physician bought all my herbs last week. Someone important is ailing.
fact.thornhaven_fall.beggar_1: I was in the lower ward when they came. The screaming... I still hear it.
fact.ironholt_warden.beggar_1: The rich flee west. The poor die in the mud. It's always been this way.
location.thornhaven.desc: A muddy frontier settlement that grew from an old military outpost. The northern gate to the untamed wilds.
location.ironholt.desc: A fortress town carved into the mountainside. Its forges burn day and night, and its gates have never been breached.
location.mistwood.desc: A settlement on the fog-shrouded eastern peninsula. Reachable only when the causeway is above the tide.
location.duskhollow.desc: A port town built atop the ruins of an older civilization. Its deepwater harbor sees strange ships from across the Veiled Sea.
service.temple.heading: ⛪ Temple
service.temple.desc: Sacred light fills the chamber. A priest offers to cleanse your ailments.
service.blacksmith.heading: 🔧 Blacksmith
service.blacksmith.desc: The forge blazes hot. The smith can sharpen your blade and reinforce your armor.
